subject: SECURITY HIGH: AchievementManager and GameTracker are console-callable globals with no server validation
description: PROVEN by Mallory 2026-08-09 with Puppeteer against unmodified cloud-cold-horizon.html served locally, AccessGuard satisfied normally. The sortie's own graded decision is SAFE: typeof decide is undefined at global scope, confirming the module-scoping claim, so decide() genuinely cannot be console-called. But you do not need it. AchievementManager.unlock('game_coldhorizon') and GameTracker.record('cold-horizon',{result:'success',score:300,timeElapsed:1}) ARE directly callable as classic-script globals, reachable by bare identifier from devtools even though window.X is undefined (the lexical-binding shape already documented on this platform). Result: the achievement unlocked, two meta-achievements chained (Podium Finish, Record Setter), a fabricated rank-1 record with bestTime 1s and no scan/flight/decision, and +1000 XP written to localStorage hexworth_progress via GameTracker._awardHighScoreXP. Confirmed on a second channel by reading localStorage back. On its own this is a local artifact; combined with task 304 it becomes a permanent cloud-backed record. Platform-wide, affects every game on the platform, not just Cold Horizon. AchievementManager.unlock is at _app/components/AchievementManager.js:1195 and is purely localStorage.
